positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop and maintain responsive front-end interfaces using frameworks such as React, Angular, HTML, and CSS
Design and implement server-side logic, application architecture, and backend services using Java, Node.js, Python, and PHP
Build, integrate, and maintain RESTful APIs and work with microservices architecture for scalable solutions
Manage code deployment, version control, and CI/CD workflows using GitHub, Jenkins, cloud platforms, and containerization tools
Ensure code quality through testing, debugging, and regular maintenance of applications
Collaborate within Agile (Scrum) teams, working closely with designers, project managers, and engineering peers

positions.title: Network Technician
positions.description:
Provided end-user technical support across multiple school sites, resolving hardware and software issues through Incident IQ ticketing system and remote assistance tools. 
Assisted in network device setup, endpoint configuration, and Chromebook provisioning for over 22,000 users using script.
Supported district-wide network maintenance and security compliance to safeguard data integrity.
Collaborated with the IT team to ensure seamless deployment and functionality of instructional technology.
positions.insights: Skills: Team Building · Leadership Development · Mac & PC platforms · System Administration · Computer Support · Customer Service Management

positions.title: IT Support Intern
positions.description:
Delivered desktop, printer, and peripheral support for internal users, resolving connectivity and configuration issues promptly.
Managed device imaging, software installation, and inventory tracking to maintain operational reliability.
Performed remote troubleshooting and implemented patch updates to ensure security compliance.
Assisted in network configuration and hardware setup to support UAS operations.

positions.title: Player
positions.description:
• Competed in hands-on cybersecurity challenges, enhancing skills in cryptography, network analysis, and ethical hacking.  
• Collaborated with team members to solve complex problems, fostering a strong sense of teamwork and communication.  
• Achieved top rankings in multiple competitions, demonstrating my commitment to continuous learning and improvement.  
• Engaged with the National Cyber League, a platform dedicated to developing cybersecurity talent through competitive challenges.
